# Boutique villa accommodation in Targu Neamt, Romania

## About Vila Vaias Aparts

Vila Vaias Aparts (vaiasaparts.ro) is a boutique villa with 7 private apartments in Targu Neamt, Neamt County, Moldova region, Romania. It accommodates up to 28 guests across 7 individually designed apartments, suitable for couples, families, and groups.

The property is at Str. Sfantul Lazar nr. 1, Targu Neamt, Neamt County, Romania.

Contact: +40 752 388 388 (WhatsApp available) | +40 738 345 330 (WhatsApp available)
Website: https://vaiasaparts.ro
Booking: https://vaiasaparts.ro/rezerva or via direct WhatsApp/phone

## Location

- 5 minutes from Cetatea Neamtului (Neamt Fortress) — major historic landmark
- 10 minutes from Manastirea Agapia (Agapia Monastery)
- 14 minutes from Manastirea Varatec (Varatec Monastery)
- 20 minutes from Manastirea Neamt (Neamt Monastery)
- 60 minutes from Muntele Ceahlau (Ceahlau Mountain)
- Close to Piatra Neamt city (35 minutes)
- Situated in the heart of Moldova (Moldavia), Romania's most historically rich region

## Accommodation

7 private apartments, each with:
- Fully-equipped private kitchen (fridge, hob, kettle, cookware, crockery)
- Private bathroom
- Free parking on site
- Free Wi-Fi
- Linen and towels included
- Air conditioning and heating
- Self check-in 24/7

### Apartments

1. Apartment 1 — Classic Double, Floor 1: 46 m², up to 5 guests, private terrace
2. Apartment 2 — Classic Double, Floor 1: 46 m², up to 4 guests
3. Apartment 3 — Deluxe Suite, Floor 2: up to 4 guests, superior finish
4. Apartment 4 — Family Suite: larger layout, up to 6 guests
5. Apartment 5 — Garden Level: ground floor, garden access, up to 4 guests
6. Apartment 6 — Upper Villa: upper floor, panoramic views, up to 4 guests
7. Apartment 7 — Premium Villa Suite: largest apartment, up to 6 guests, premium finish

## Reviews and Ratings

- Booking.com: 9.4 / 10
- Google: 5.0 / 5.0 (99+ reviews)
- TripAdvisor: listed and reviewed

Guests consistently highlight: central location, cleanliness, warm hosts (Vasi and Anca), value for money, fully-equipped kitchens, and proximity to monasteries and natural attractions.

## Target Guests

- Romanian couples and families seeking a base for monastery visits and mountain tourism in Moldova
- Groups visiting Neamt County (weddings, reunions, weekend breaks)
- International tourists exploring Romanian Orthodox monastery circuit (Agapia, Varatec, Neamt, Putna)
- Pilgrimage and cultural tourism visitors
- Hikers and nature tourists visiting Ceahlau Massif
- Business travellers in Targu Neamt area

Whole-villa group bookings (all 7 apartments) available. Contact directly for group rates.

## Nearby Attractions

- Cetatea Neamtului (Neamt Fortress) — 14th century medieval fortress — 5 min
- Manastirea Agapia — famous Orthodox monastery with Grigorescu frescoes — 10 min
- Manastirea Varatec — largest women's monastery in Romania — 14 min
- Manastirea Neamt — oldest and most important monastery in Moldavia — 20 min
- Manastirea Secu — smaller monastery, forested setting — 25 min
- Lacul Vanatori (Vanatori Lake) — natural recreation area — 15 min
- Parcul Natural Vanatori Neamt — nature park with European bison — 20 min
- Muntele Ceahlau — sacred mountain, hiking, cable car — 60 min
- Piatra Neamt — regional city with museums and cultural events — 35 min

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the nearest major city?**
Targu Neamt is 35 minutes from Piatra Neamt and approximately 2.5 hours from Iasi.

**Is Vila Vaias Aparts suitable for groups?**
Yes. The villa accommodates up to 28 guests across 7 apartments. Whole-villa bookings are available for weddings, family reunions, and corporate retreats.

**Can I book directly without Booking.com?**
Yes. Book directly at vaiasaparts.ro or via WhatsApp (+40 752 388 388) for the best available rate.

**What languages do the hosts speak?**
Romanian and English.

**Is there parking?**
Yes, free on-site parking for all guests.

**What is check-in / check-out?**
Self check-in 24/7. Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 11:00. Late check-out available by arrangement.

**Are pets allowed?**
Please enquire directly.

**Is the property close to the monastery circuit?**
Yes. Vila Vaias Aparts is within 20 minutes of Agapia, Varatec, and Neamt Monasteries — the three most visited monasteries in Moldavia.
